refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
handle
The handle to watch. If it is a StreamPollHandle whose stream is not backed by a file descriptor, an E_WARNING is emitted in addition to the exception.
events
A non-empty list of Io\Poll\Event cases. It combines the conditions to watch for, such as Io\Poll\Event::Read and Io\Poll\Event::Write, with the Io\Poll\Event::OneShot and Io\Poll\Event::EdgeTriggered modifiers.
data
An arbitrary value to associate with the watcher, for example a callback or an object describing the connection. It is returned by Io\Poll\Watcher::getData.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a TypeError if events is empty or contains a value that is not an Io\Poll\Event case.
Throws an Io\Poll\InvalidHandleException if handle cannot be polled, for example because its stream was closed or is not backed by a file descriptor.
Throws an Io\Poll\HandleAlreadyWatchedException if handle is already watched by this context.
Throws an Io\Poll\FailedHandleAddException if the backend rejects the registration, for example when a regular file is added to a context that uses Io\Poll\Backend::Epoll, or when Io\Poll\Event::EdgeTriggered is requested from Io\Poll\Backend::Poll.
